scenes.name: THE MISS · 错身
lines: Three forces, three running couplings. Do they meet at a single energy?
三种力，三条跑动耦合。它们会在同一个能标相遇吗？
Start from measured values at the Z mass, and run them upward with Standard Model one-loop slopes.
从 Z 玻色子质量处的实测值出发，按标准模型单圈斜率向上跑。
The lines pass each other in a small triangle. They never share one point.
三条直线错身而过，围出一个小三角，从不共点。
Where lines one and three cross, line two sits three point six six units higher.
在第一、三条线的交点处，第二条线高出 3.66 个单位。

scenes.name: THE BLIND COMBINATION · 盲视组合
lines: Why so stubborn? Take one combination: line one, minus three times line two, plus two times line three.
为什么如此顽固？取一个组合：第一条线，减三倍第二条，加两倍第三条。
It cannot see a shared coupling, a complete family, or heavy gauge vectors: every dot product is zero.
它看不见共同耦合、完整家族与重规范矢量：每个点积都是零。
The light fields lift it by only one over five pi per unit of log energy.
轻场每走一个对数能量单位，只把它抬高 1/(5π)。
It starts at minus twelve point eight, and by ten to the seventeen GeV it has climbed only two point two.
它从 −12.8 出发，到 10¹⁷ GeV 只爬升了 2.2。

scenes.name: THE MAGNETIC SHELL · 磁球壳
lines: So the heavy spectrum must tear multiplets apart. Can the nineteen-point shell do that by itself?
所以重谱必须把多重态撕开。十九点球壳能自己做到吗？
On the shell, a charged magnetic Laplacian has eigenvalues lambda. Its neutral positive eigenvalues average fifteen.
球壳上的带荷磁拉普拉斯算子有本征值 λ；中性正本征值的均值是 15。
The two-step mass reading is lambda times its distance from fifteen. The curve folds back to zero there.
两步质量读数是 λ 乘以它到 15 的距离：曲线在那里折回到零。
The weak centre splits the fields: doublets are odd, singlets and neutral vectors are even.
弱中心把场分成两扇：双重态为奇，单态与中性矢量为偶。

scenes.name: FOUR WALLS · 四道墙
lines: Inside this model, interval certificates raise four walls against the crossing.
在这个模型里，区间证书立起四道挡住交汇的墙。
Native generators sharing high modes: the spread of the three lines stays above two point nine three six.
原生生成元共用高模：三线极差始终大于 2.936。
Short-step face weights: the strong coupling at the Z mass stays below zero point zero seven six.
短步正面权：Z 质量处的强耦合始终低于 0.076。
A Planck-pinned mass unit: the spread stays above two point zero three seven.
质量单位钉在普朗克尺度：极差始终大于 2.037。

scenes.name: THE MONOTONE WALL · 单调之墙
lines: The sharpest wall: let every heavy field share one mass rule that never decreases.
最锋利的一道墙：让所有重场共用同一条从不下降的质量规则。
Any such rule, at every phase of the double-clock torus, leaves a spread above zero point seven at sharp thresholds.
任何这样的规则，在双时钟环面的每个相位上，尖阈值下都留下大于 0.7 的极差。
Even one plain eighteen-layer tower would need a log slope of at least one hundred six point seven five.
即使只有一座十八层的普通重塔，对数斜率也至少要 106.75。
If the rule is log-convex, its mass span must exceed eighty-two log units. Z mass to reduced Planck mass is under thirty-eight.
若规则对数凸，质量跨度须超过 82 个对数单位；而从 Z 质量到约化普朗克质量不到 38。

scenes.name: CONDITIONAL CROSSINGS · 条件交汇
lines: Two keys open a crossing, each on conditions. Key one: make the even sector thirty-two times heavier.
两把钥匙能打开交汇，各带条件。钥匙一：把偶扇区加重 32 倍。
Fix the unit with clock chord seven twenty-four: at zero eleven six six one, the strong coupling comes out zero point one one eight four.
以钟弦 724 定绝对单位，第 11661 枚黎曼零点反推出强耦合 0.1184。
Key two: normalize every step by thirty-two. The readout is zero point one one eight nine.
钥匙二：每一步按 32 归一化。读数是 0.1189。
Both are model rules chosen after seeing the fit. Swap the matching rule, and key two's masses give zero point one five three.
两者都是看过拟合后才提出的模型规则。换一种匹配处方，钥匙二的同一组质量给出 0.153。

scenes.name: THE BEDROCK · 基石
lines: Under all of this lie two exact tools, checked by the Lean kernel.
这一切之下，是两件由 Lean 内核检验的精确工具。
Lagrange and Gram: the Cauchy-Schwarz deficit is half a sum of squares. Here both sides are fifty-four.
拉格朗日—格拉姆：柯西—施瓦茨亏量等于平方和的一半。这里两边都是 54。
On the norm five LPS shell, the integer matrices match, and twenty minus lambda squared stays positive on every branch.
在模方 5 的 LPS 壳层上，整数矩阵精确匹配，20 − λ² 在每个分支上都为正。
Kernel-checked: the tools. Certified in the model: the walls. Conditional: every crossing so far.
内核检验的：工具。模型内证书的：墙。有条件的：迄今每一次交汇。

scenes.name: WALLS
lines: Omega Unification, chapter four.
《OMEGA 统一》· 第四章
